final_text:
Task complete. Summary:

- Wrote `out/T5/solution.py`: a plain script on `torch`+`safetensors` that loads the 32 LoRA A/B pairs, merges `W += (alpha/r) * B @ A` in float32 for `self_attn.{q,v}_proj` across all 16 layers, writes the other 82 tensors unchanged, and shards the result at ≤512 MiB tensor data per shard (oversized `embed_tokens`/`lm_head` get their own shard), with fail-loud checks for the pair count (32), absence of `lora_` names, `q_proj` shape, and total tensor count (114).
- `out/T5/run.sh` runs it via the repo `.venv`.
- Verified against inputs directly: merged value for a spot-checked layer matches `base + 2·B@A` bit-for-bit under `torch.allclose`, an unchanged tensor is bit-exact, output has 114 tensors, no `lora_` names, and every shard is ≤ 536,870,912 bytes of tensor data.
- Wrote `out/T5/REPORT.md` with the self-report, including the one failed first attempt (short vs. full module-name mismatch against `target_modules`) and rationale for using plain torch/safetensors over `peft.merge_and_unload`.
